11029|bbb4a5a5.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|bbb4a5a5.text: The plans for my twenty-foot tall turkey baster are nearly complete! Now all I need is a twenty-foot tall turkey...

1430|52392408.name: Tomas
1430|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

1680|279d82d3.name: Matthew Hooper
1680|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

1976|8e658029.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|8e658029.text: Shamanism? We don't do that here. Try Ironforge.

1976|e1cab2c5.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|e1cab2c5.text: There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.  I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook.  Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.

4262|d3a25a4e.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|d3a25a4e.text: Alegorn is a masterful chef who has had centuries with which to perfect his cooking.  You should consider yourself blessed should he decide to teach you.  If you believe you are worthy, you can find him in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

5153|ab3a58ee.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|ab3a58ee.text: I don't have time to babysit! Go talk to me assistant, Uthrar!

5161|6aaffb9a.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|6aaffb9a.text: Yap, I can teach ye to fish.

5595|00ef3512.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|00ef3512.text: Grimnur Stonebrand will tell ye some whoppers about the one that got away, but he's still one o' the best fishermen around.  He's got a shop set up in The Forlorn Cavern called the Traveling Fisherman.

5595|329c6da9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|329c6da9.text: A valuable skill First Aid is.  Our resident trainer, Nissa Firestone, can show ye how it's done.  Look for her on the southern side of The Great Forge at the Ironforge Physician.

5595|3b9d531b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3b9d531b.text:
Oh, you're looking for Springspindle Fizzlegear then.  Why that little $r and his gadgets...  Let me tell you, if you're going to his shop in Tinker Town, keep your hands to yourself and don't pet any of his mechanical sheep!  

Exploding sheep... now why would you even make such a thing!?

5595|61f33a42.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|61f33a42.text:
The tinkerer's craft for you is it?  No doubt ye'll want to go see Springspindle Fizzlegear in Tinker Town.  

Just head east from the gates of Ironforge, or follow the sound of the explosions.

5595|8ba947c0.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8ba947c0.text: I once heard ol' Grimnur say he fished up a sword.  Or was it a swordfish?  Damn that Grimnur, he's told so many fish tales I can't remember which is which.  Well, why don't you go see him over in The Forlorn Cavern and have him tell you what it was.

5595|8f7146fb.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f7146fb.text:
Bah!  Mailboxes...  all I get is junk mail lately!  

Increase the size of this... decrease the size of that... act now for your free Sword of Dragonslaying.  I have to change my mailbox number every other month!  

Well, ye can't say I didn't warn ye.  If you're looking for the mailbox it's just outside the Stonefire Tavern.

5595|9acb23a3.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|9acb23a3.text: First Aid?  Well ye don't look hurt to me.  If yer really interested in learning First Aid, then Nissa Firestone is the one to learn from.  Go see her over by The Great Forge in her shop, The Ironforge Physician.

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire
